blocked_by.description: Created BLOCKED: one or more dependencies not yet COMPLETE

acceptance_criteria.criterion: `color()` wraps text in correct ANSI escape sequences for at least: green, red, yellow, cyan, bold.
`color()` detects Windows (`PHP_OS_FAMILY === 'Windows'`) and strips/bypasses ANSI codes when the terminal does not support them.
`prompt()` displays the label with the default value in brackets, returns the default when the user presses Enter with empty input.
`promptPassword()` uses `stty -echo` on Unix to hide input and restores echo afterward; on Windows, falls back to visible input.
All functions are wrapped in `function_exists()` guards.
